high_level_description: The image is a bar chart titled "PROFESSORS ARE DEMOCRATS Therefore, 'experts' are Democrats too." The chart presents data on the political affiliations of professors across various academic disciplines. It shows the percentage of professors who identify as Democrats (blue bars) and Republicans (red bars) among 5116 surveyed professors. The title at the top of the chart reads: "PROFESSORS ARE DEMOCRATS Therefore, 'experts' are Democrats too." This suggests that the chart aims to imply a correlation between academic fields and political leanings
